highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia M156 and broadens native rendering support across desktop platforms.
highlights_body: This line adds GTK4 GPU rendering, restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments, and aligns upcoming .NET and native toolchain assets.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia M156 and incorporates the current core-fork cleanup.
NoDependencies deployments can again locate fonts installed on Linux systems.
Adds GPU-backed rendering and pixel scaling for the GTK4 integration.
Aligns Windows toolchains, Tizen packaging, .NET 11 preview assets, and the WinUI Windows SDK configuration.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp build assets alongside the updated Windows and Tizen native toolchains.
